options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the grid.

options.name: description
options.description: Accessible description of the grid (aria-describedby).

options.name: columns
options.description: Columns and column groups (nested). Column: id, header, accessor or field, type, currency, format, render, align, width, minWidth, maxWidth, flex, resizable, movable, pinned, lockPinned, lockPosition, hidden, sortable, compare, headerTooltip, wrapHeader, wrapText, rowDrag (this column holds the row drag handle; default the first data column), tooltip (true, a text, or (value, row) => text; with the tooltips accessory), spanRows (true or (a, b) => boolean: merge equal adjacent values), colSpan (row => columns covered), cellClass, cellClassRules, flashOnChange, copyValue, exportable, formula (a calculated column with the formulas option: [Column] is the same row, A1 references and functions as in spreadsheets; read-only), formulas (cell formulas: values that are text starting with = are evaluated; editing shows the formula; fill, Ctrl+D, and paste of copied cells move relative A1 references), excel (Excel export: style, cellStyle(row), numberFormat, formula(row, ref), link(row), image(row), width) (false leaves the column out of CSV and Excel exports of visible or all columns), aggregate, showAs, groupable, groupHierarchy, editable, setValue, parseValue, editor, required, validate, filter, filterValue, filterCaseSensitive, filterAccentSensitive, filterValues, businessCalendar, searchable, visibleWhen. Group: id, header, children, collapsible, collapsed, headerTooltip.

options.name: rows
options.description: Row data (never mutated).

options.name: rowId
options.description: Stable, unique, non-empty id per row.

options.name: rowHeight
options.description: Row height in pixels (16 to 1000), or a function of the row. Default by density: 32, 40, or 48.

options.name: autoRowHeight
options.description: Measure rendered rows and let them grow to their content (with wrapText columns); the scroll position stays anchored.

options.name: layout
options.description: fill: fills the host (which needs a height). auto: grows with its rows up to the host max-block-size.

options.name: sort
options.description: Current sort by priority: { column, direction: "ascending" | "descending" }.

options.name: pageSize
options.description: Rows per page (1 to 1,000,000); null shows every row in one virtualized grid.

options.name: pageSizes
options.description: Offer a "Rows per page" choice with these sizes.

options.name: page
options.description: Current page, 1-based (clamped).

options.name: filters
options.description: Active column filters by column id (JSON models: text, number, bigint, date with relative and business ranges, boolean, set). Validated; DATA_GRID_FILTER on malformed models.

options.name: quickFilter
options.description: Rows must contain every word in some searchable visible column (case- and accent-insensitive).

options.name: externalFilter
options.description: Application filter applied with the others; call refreshFilters() when its result may change.

options.name: floatingFilters
options.description: A header row of compact filter controls under the column headers: text contains, number syntax (5, >5, <=10, !=0, 5..10), date, boolean choice, set summary; complex filters show a read-only summary.

options.name: searchBox
options.description: A search box above the grid (role search) that sets the quick filter as the user types.

options.name: advancedFilter
options.description: An expression bar with type-ahead suggestions and a builder dialog replaces the column filter UI; column filters stop applying while it is on.

options.name: advancedFilterModel
options.description: The advanced filter: { join, items } of conditions { column, filter } and nested groups. Validated (DATA_GRID_FILTER); conditions on unknown columns are dropped.

options.name: rowSelection
options.description: Row selection: { mode: 'single' | 'multiple', checkboxes (default true; a checkbox column pinned first), headerCheckbox (default true), selectAll: 'filtered' (default) | 'all' | 'page', clickToSelect (default false), selectable(row) }.

options.name: selected
options.description: Selected row ids (unknown and unselectable ids are dropped; kept by id across sort, filter, paging, and updates).

options.name: cellSelection
options.description: Cell ranges: drag, Ctrl+drag adds, Shift+click and Shift+arrows extend, Ctrl+A selects all; { multiple (default true), columnSelection (header Enter or click selects the column; sorting moves to Alt), fillHandle (drag the corner to fill a series; Alt repeats or counts; double-click fills down) }.

options.name: copyHeaders
options.description: Copy column headers above copied cells.

options.name: readOnlyEdits
options.description: Writes (paste, cut, Delete, fill, edits) are only requested: aui-cells-change reports them with applied: false and the application applies them.

options.name: clickToEdit
options.description: A single click on an editable cell starts editing (otherwise Enter, F2, typing, Backspace, or a double-click).

options.name: enterMovesDown
options.description: Enter commits an edit and moves to the cell below.

options.name: invalidEdit
options.description: An invalid edit keeps the editor open with an announced message (block), or is discarded (revert). Focus leaving the editor discards an invalid value.

options.name: undoLimit
options.description: Undo steps kept for edits, paste, cut, Delete, fill, and bulk edit (0 turns undo off); cleared when the application replaces or updates rows.

options.name: editMode
options.description: row: editing opens every editable cell of the row; Tab moves within it; Enter commits the row as one write and one undo step.

options.name: validateRow
options.description: Row mode: cross-field validation; a message (or messages by column) blocks the commit.

options.name: groupBy
options.description: Group the rows by these columns (in level order). The grid becomes a treegrid with a generated group column (key, count, expansion); grouped columns hide (hideGroupedColumns).

options.name: groupDefaultExpanded
options.description: Levels expanded by default (0: all collapsed; -1: all expanded).

options.name: groupTotals
options.description: A total row after each expanded group.

options.name: grandTotal
options.description: A grand total row at the top or bottom of the rows, or pinned above or below them (pinnedTop, pinnedBottom); flat grids too.

options.name: groupDisplay
options.description: One generated group column indented by level, one per level (named after the grouped column; date parts in parentheses), or rows: group rows drawn as one cell across the row (no group column; not for tree data or pivot mode).

options.name: stickyGroupRows
options.description: While grouped, the group rows of the topmost row stay under the header as their groups scroll (copies hidden from assistive technology; their toggles work).

options.name: fullWidthRow
options.type: { isFullWidth: (row: Row) => boolean; render: (row: Row, context: { doc, rowId }) => Node } | null
options.description: Rows drawn as one cell across every column (it stays in view while the rows scroll sideways); never edited, filled, or part of ranges.

options.name: groupColumn
options.description: Header text and width of the generated group column.

options.name: hideGroupedColumns
options.description: Hide grouped columns while grouped.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Group rows expanded or collapsed explicitly, by group id.

options.name: groupPanel
options.description: A panel above the grid lists the row groups: move earlier, move later, remove, add a groupable column; dropping a groupable header on it groups by that column; pills can be dragged to reorder, or out of the panel to remove (the buttons are the keyboard path).

options.name: aggregateFilteredOnly
options.description: Aggregates use only the rows that pass the filters; false aggregates every row of each group.

options.name: accessories
options.description: Accessories from @absoluteui/components/data-grid/accessories: columnMenu(), contextMenu(), columnChooser() (built on Context Menu and Dialog, outside the core bundle). The grid must be in the document when they attach.

options.name: headerNames
options.description: Header names set by the user, by column or column group id (part of the columns state as headers).

options.name: pinnedTopRows
options.description: Rows always shown above the body in a section named "Pinned to top" (never sorted, filtered, grouped, selected, or edited; at most 1000).

options.name: pinnedBottomRows
options.description: Rows always shown below the body in a section named "Pinned to bottom".

options.name: pinned
options.description: Rows pinned to the top or bottom by id (they also stay in the body; filters hide the pinned copy).

options.name: formulas
options.description: The formula engine for calculated columns: formulaEngine({ functions?, calendar? }) from @absoluteui/components/data-grid/formulas (our own parser and evaluator; no eval). Results recalculate when rows change; errors show their code (#DIV/0!, #REF!, ...) with the meaning read out.

options.name: fileDrop
options.type: { onFiles: (files) => void; accept?: string[]; label?: string }
options.description: Files dropped on the grid: an overlay (aui-data-grid__file-drop, default text "Drop files to load") shows while files are over it; files matching accept (extensions such as .csv, MIME types such as text/csv or text/*; default all) go to onFiles, others are announced. Pointer only: offer a file input too. With parseCsv from @absoluteui/helpers/csv, coerceCsvValues, and inferColumns an app can load a dropped CSV with generated columns.

options.name: rowDragging
options.type: boolean | { managed?: boolean; multiRow?: boolean; canDrag?: (row) => boolean; nativeData?: (rows) => Record<string, string> }
options.description: Row dragging: a drag handle in the rowDrag column (pointer: a drop line, or a target row in parent-id tree data), and Ctrl+Shift+ArrowUp / ArrowDown on a handle cell (in trees Ctrl+Shift+ArrowRight / ArrowLeft indent and outdent); announced. managed: the grid moves the rows (one undo step) while not sorted, filtered, grouped, pivoted, or server-side; multiRow: dragging a selected row drags every selected row; canDrag limits the rows. nativeData: the handle uses native drag and drop and the drag carries that data (MIME type to text) to other apps; drops on the rows and on zones work as with the pointer. Drop zones: addRowDropZone, rowDropZone.

options.name: rowNumbers
options.description: A leading column numbering the rows by display position (width 32 to 200, default 56); with cell ranges a click on a number selects the row's cells; resizable adds a handle (drag, or Alt+ArrowUp / Alt+ArrowDown on the number) that sets the row's height.

options.name: datasource
options.description: Server row model: { getRows(request, signal) => Promise<{ rows, rowCount? }> } (request: start, end, sort, filters, quickFilter, advancedFilter, groupBy, groupKeys); with groupBy the top level loads group rows and each expanded group loads its own rows; rows load in blocks as they scroll into view, and sort, filters, the quick filter, and the advanced filter run on the server (rows is ignored; pass []). An unknown rowCount grows block by block until a short block.

options.name: blockSize
options.description: Rows per datasource request (1 to 10000).

options.name: maxBlocks
options.description: Loaded blocks kept; the least recently used are released (null keeps all).

options.name: blockLoadDelay
options.description: Milliseconds to wait before loading while scrolling (0 to 5000).

options.name: maxConcurrentLoads
options.description: Datasource requests at a time (1 to 20).

options.name: initialRowCount
options.description: Rows assumed before the first answer (the scrollbar size).

options.name: getChildCount
options.description: Server groups: the number of rows below a group row (shown with its key); null when unknown.

options.name: purgeClosedGroups
options.description: Server groups: collapsing a group releases its loaded rows (they load again when it expands).

options.name: pivot
options.description: Pivot mode: { rows, columns, values: [{ column, aggregate: sum | count | avg | min | max | distinctCount }] }; rows group by the row fields, a column group per column key holds a result column per value, with total columns; the data columns hide.

options.name: pivotPanel
options.description: A panel above the grid edits the pivot: rows, columns, and values zones with pills (move, remove; an aggregate per value) and pickers; pills can be dragged within and between zones (a value keeps its aggregate, a new value gets sum or count) or out of the panel to remove.

options.name: pivotMaxColumns
options.description: Most generated pivot result columns (1 to 100000); more are left out, announced, and reported by getPivotTruncation().

options.name: detail
options.description: Master/detail: { render(row, { doc, rowId }) => Node, height (px, default 300, or auto), isMaster(row), keep (collapsed details kept, default 10), expandedByDefault, destroy(node, row) }; a generated toggle column expands a detail row under each master row.

options.name: treeData
options.description: Tree data: exactly one of serverGroup with serverKey (with a datasource: parents load their children from the server when expanded), getPath (row => string[]; missing levels become filler rows), parentIdField (self-referential; missing parents and cycles become root rows), or childrenField (nested rows); label names the column that labels rows in the group column. groupBy is ignored.

options.name: treeFilter
options.description: Filtering keeps the ancestors of matching rows; subtree also keeps the rows below a matching row.

options.name: flashChanges
options.description: Highlight cells whose displayed text changes when rows are updated (setRows, transactions); columns can opt in with flashOnChange.

options.name: flashDuration
options.description: Milliseconds a changed cell stays highlighted (100 to 10000).

options.name: rowClassRules
options.description: Classes added to a row while their predicate is true (re-evaluated on every render).

options.name: loading
options.description: Busy state: aria-busy and an announced loading overlay; rows stay in place.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: Text of the single grid cell shown when there are no rows. Default "No rows to show".

options.name: multiSort
options.description: Shift+click and Shift+Enter add a column to the sort.

options.name: sortCycle
options.description: tri-state: ascending, descending, unsorted. bi-state: ascending, descending.

options.name: overscan
options.description: Rows rendered beyond each edge of the viewport (0 to 200).

options.name: transactionDelay
options.description: Milliseconds between applying queued applyTransactionAsync batches (0 to 10000).

options.name: animateRows
options.description: Rows glide to their new position after a sort or update (off with reduced motion or animation none).

options.name: filterDelay
options.description: Milliseconds after typing stops before a typed filter value applies (0 to 10000); Enter applies at once.

options.name: maxFilterConditions
options.description: Conditions offered per text, number, and date filter in the filter panel (1 to 10).

options.name: locale
options.description: Formatting, collation, and messages locale.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA time zone for datetime columns.

options.name: density
options.description: Row and header heights and cell padding.

options.name: direction
options.description: Layout direction (pinned sides, arrow keys, resizing mirror).

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides (sortAscending, sortDescending, sortNone, expand, collapse, loading, filter, drag).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer-provided host (children are owned by the grid).

properties.name: rowCount
properties.description: Rows displayed (the current page when paging).

properties.name: focusedCell
properties.description: The cell or header holding the tab stop: { rowId, column } or { rowId: null, column, level }.

properties.name: filteredRowCount
properties.description: Rows that pass the filters (before paging).

properties.name: isBatchEditing
properties.description: A batch is collecting pending values.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options.

methods.name: setRows
methods.description: Replace the rows; sort, focus, and scroll position are kept.

methods.name: applyTransaction
methods.description: Add, update (by id), and remove (by id) rows; sort is re-applied and rows keep their identity. Emits aui-rows-change; unknown ids are reported in missing.

methods.name: applyTransactionAsync
methods.description: Queue a transaction; queued ones are applied together every transactionDelay ms.

methods.name: flushTransactions
methods.description: Apply queued transactions now.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Active column filters (copies).

methods.name: setFilter
methods.signature: setFilter(column: string, filter: DataGridFilter | null): void
methods.description: Set or clear one column filter (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: setQuickFilter
methods.description: Set the quick filter text (emits nothing).

methods.name: refreshFilters
methods.description: Re-run the filters (for example after the external filter changed).

methods.name: getAdvancedFilter
methods.description: The advanced filter model (a copy).

methods.name: setAdvancedFilter
methods.description: Set or clear the advanced filter model (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: Selected row ids, in source order.

methods.name: getSelectedRows
methods.description: Selected rows, in source order.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Replace the selection (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Select every selectable row in the scope (default: rowSelection.selectAll; emits nothing).

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clear the selection (emits nothing).

methods.name: getCellRanges
methods.description: Cell ranges (copies), the active one last.

methods.name: addCellRange
methods.description: Add a range of displayed rows and visible columns (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: clearCellRanges
methods.description: Clear the cell ranges (emits nothing).

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copy the ranges, else the selected rows, else the focused cell, with the asynchronous Clipboard API; returns the tab-separated text.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.description: Start editing a displayed, editable cell.

methods.name: stopEditing
methods.description: Commit the open edit (an invalid value is discarded) or cancel it.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last applied write or managed row move.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redo the last undone write.

methods.name: startBatch
methods.description: Collect writes as pending values (shown and spoken as edited; sorting and filtering keep committed data).

methods.name: commitBatch
methods.description: Apply the pending values as one transaction and one undo step (source batch).

methods.name: cancelBatch
methods.description: Discard the pending values.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expand every group row (emits nothing).

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapse every group row (emits nothing).

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expand or collapse one group row (emits nothing).

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: The current groups: ids, columns, keys, counts, aggregates, and children.

methods.name: moveRow
methods.signature: moveRow(id: string, parentId: string | null, index: number): boolean
methods.description: Tree data with parentIdField: move a row under another parent (null: a root) at a position among its new siblings; the row is a shallow copy (never mutated); false for unknown ids, moves into its own subtree, and other tree modes. Emits aui-rows-change.

methods.name: alignWith
methods.description: Keep another grid's columns (order, widths, pinning, visibility, collapsed groups) and horizontal scroll in step with this one, both ways (for example a totals grid under the main grid); the other grid takes this grid's columns now. Returns a function ending it; destroying either grid ends it.

methods.name: addRowDropZone
methods.description: Let rows dragged from this grid drop on an element outside it: { element, label, onDrop, onDragEnter?, onDragMove?, onDragLeave? }, each called with { rowIds, rows, x, y, grid }. The element gets aui-data-grid-drop-zone--active while rows are over it; the cell menu's Send to submenu lists zones by label (the keyboard path, x and y null). Returns a function removing the zone.

methods.name: rowDropZone
methods.signature: rowDropZone(options?: { label?: string; move?: boolean }): DataGridRowDropZone<Row>
methods.description: A zone for another grid's addRowDropZone adding the dropped rows to this grid (at the drop line when its rows are in source order, else at the end; ids already present are skipped); move removes the added rows from the source grid.

methods.name: setColumnHeader
methods.signature: setColumnHeader(id: string, header: string | null): boolean
methods.description: Rename a column or column group (null restores its defined header); false for unknown ids. Emits aui-columns-change (rename).

methods.name: resetColumns
methods.description: Undo the user's column changes (order, widths, pinning, visibility, collapsed groups, names). Emits aui-columns-change (reset).

methods.name: pinRow
methods.description: Pin a row by id to the top or bottom, or unpin it; false for unknown ids (emits nothing).

methods.name: getPinnedRows
methods.description: Ids of the rows pinned by id, by section, in pin order.

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.signature: setRowHeight(rowId: string, height: number | null): void
methods.description: Set a row's height in px (16 to 2000), or null for its default height (emits nothing).

methods.name: applyServerTransaction
methods.description: Server row model: apply changes the server already holds to the loaded rows (add at addIndex, update, remove by id; later rows shift; rowCount corrects the total); rows that are not loaded are reported missing. Emits aui-rows-change.

methods.name: getServerSelection
methods.description: Server row model: the selection state; with selectAll, toggled lists the rows not selected.

methods.name: setServerSelection
methods.signature: setServerSelection(state: { selectAll: boolean; toggled: string[] }): void
methods.description: Server row model: set the selection state (multiple selection only; emits nothing).

methods.name: refresh
methods.signature: refresh(options?: { purge?: boolean; route?: readonly unknown[] }): void
methods.description: Server row model: reload the loaded blocks; purge drops them first (loading rows show).

methods.name: retryLoads
methods.description: Server row model: load failed blocks again (never done automatically).

methods.name: setRowCount
methods.description: Server row model: set the row count; known false keeps growing it as blocks arrive.

methods.name: isRowCountKnown
methods.description: Server row model: whether the total row count is known (always true for client rows).

methods.name: getPivot
methods.description: Pivot mode: the current pivot, or null.

methods.name: setPivot
methods.description: Pivot mode: set the pivot; null leaves pivot mode (emits nothing).

methods.name: getPivotTruncation
methods.signature: getPivotTruncation(): { shown: number; total: number } | null
methods.description: Pivot mode: result columns shown and in total when pivotMaxColumns left some out, else null.

methods.name: setDetailExpanded
methods.description: Master/detail: expand or collapse a master row's details; false for rows without details (emits nothing).

methods.name: isDetailExpanded
methods.description: Master/detail: whether a master row's details are expanded.

methods.name: getTreeOrphans
methods.description: Tree data: ids of rows whose parent is missing or would form a cycle (shown as root rows).

methods.name: toCsv
methods.description: RFC 4180 CSV with formula-injection protection (text starting with =, +, -, @, a tab, or a carriage return is prefixed with a quote; numbers the grid formats itself are trusted). Options: columns (visible, all, or ids), rows (filtered: across pages with group rows and totals, every group expanded; page; selected and all, ignoring filters; range: the active cell range), groups (rows or none), header, columnGroups (group rows above the header), pinned, values (formatted or raw), indent (per level for group and tree labels), delimiter, lineEnding, bom, escapeFormulas, and value(cell) for custom values. With a datasource only loaded rows exist.

methods.name: toCsvBlob
methods.description: toCsv() as a text/csv Blob; downloadCsv from the Data Table entry saves it.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.signature: cellAddress(rowId: string, column: string): string | null
methods.description: A cell's stable A1 address for formulas (column letters by column definition order, row numbers by source row order), or null without formula columns.

methods.name: cellFormula
methods.signature: cellFormula(rowId: string, column: string): string | null
methods.description: A cell's formula: the calculated column's formula or the cell formula; null for plain values.

methods.name: getExportData
methods.description: The rows and columns of an export for exporters such as toXlsx in @absoluteui/components/data-grid/export: the toCsv choices (columns, rows, groups, pinned), raw values (aggregates as numbers), display text (text: "needed" formats only where required), group levels, column group header runs, and the expansion state. No side effects.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Print the rows as a static table shown only in print media (the page itself is hidden while printing): the toCsv row and column choices (columns, rows, groups, pinned), a title (default: the grid label) as the caption, column group headers repeated on every page, group and total rows, the grid direction, and print colors. The table is removed after afterprint. More than 20,000 rows throws DATA_GRID_PRINT (page the grid or export CSV).

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serializable view state: sort, columns (order, widths, pinned, hidden, collapsed groups), page, page size; includes details (master rows expanded or collapsed), pinnedRows (pinned by id), and pivot.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Restore a view state; untrusted input is validated (DATA_GRID_STATE), unknown ids are dropped; emits nothing.

methods.name: getColumnsState
methods.description: The columns section of the state.

methods.name: moveColumn
methods.signature: moveColumn(id: string, target: string, position?: 'before' | 'after'): boolean
methods.description: Move a column or group next to a sibling with the same parent group.

methods.name: setColumnPinned
methods.signature: setColumnPinned(id: string, pinned: DataGridPinned | null): boolean
methods.description: Pin to the start or end edge, or unpin.

methods.name: setColumnHidden
methods.description: Hide or show a column (one always stays visible).

methods.name: autoSizeColumns
methods.description: Size columns to their header and rendered cells.

methods.name: fitColumns
methods.description: Scale the visible columns to the viewport width.

methods.name: focusCell
methods.description: Move focus to a cell, scrolling it into view.

methods.name: scrollToRow
methods.description: Scroll a row into view.

methods.name: scrollToColumn
methods.description: Scroll a column into view.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the grid, listeners, and released nodes.

events.name: aui-rows-change
events.description: A transaction (sync or batched) changed the rows.

events.name: aui-filter-change
events.description: The user changed a column filter, the quick filter, or the advanced filter; the row count is announced.

events.name: aui-columns-change
events.description: The user (or a method) resized, moved, pinned, hid, auto-sized, or fitted columns, or toggled a column group.

events.name: aui-page-change
events.description: The user changed the page or the page size.

events.name: aui-cell-focus
events.description: Focus moved to another cell or header.

events.name: aui-cell-activate
events.description: Enter on a cell without widgets, or a double click.

events.name: aui-selection-change
events.description: The user changed the row selection ('user', 'select-all'), or selected rows were removed ('rows'); the count is announced for user changes.

events.name: aui-range-change
events.description: The user changed the cell ranges (finished is false while a drag extends the range).

events.name: aui-cells-change
events.detail: { changes: [{ rowId, column, oldValue, newValue }], source, applied, rejected }
events.description: Cells were written by an edit, bulk edit, paste, cut, Delete, fill, undo, or redo (one transaction; with readOnlyEdits only requested, applied: false); rejected lists pasted text a column could not convert.

events.name: aui-row-group-toggle
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed a group row (announced with its row count).

events.name: aui-group-change
events.description: The user changed the row groups in the group panel (announced).

events.name: aui-detail-toggle
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed a master row's details (announced).

events.name: aui-row-pin
events.description: The user pinned or unpinned a row (announced).

events.name: aui-row-drag-start
events.description: The user started dragging rows with a drag handle.

events.name: aui-row-drop
events.description: Rows were dropped before, after, or (tree data) inside a target row, by pointer or keyboard; cancel to keep the order. Managed grids then move the rows.

events.name: aui-row-resize
events.description: The user resized a row with its row number handle (announced).

events.name: aui-pivot-change
events.description: The user changed the pivot in the pivot panel (announced).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid
cssClasses.description: Host; aui-data-grid--compact / --spacious / --auto modifiers.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid__viewport
cssClasses.description: The single scroll container (both axes).

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid__head | __header-row | __header-cell | __group-header
cssClasses.description: Sticky header rows, leaf and group header cells.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid__body | __row | __cell
cssClasses.description: Virtualized rows and cells; __cell--end / --center alignment, --wrap, --pinned-start / --pinned-end.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid__resize | __drop-indicator
cssClasses.description: Column resize handle and column drop position.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid__overlay | __empty | __pager
cssClasses.description: Loading overlay, empty-state cell, pagination host.

cssClasses.name: aui-data-grid__filter-button | __header-cell--filtered
